component.name: UpNext
component.summary: Pick what to play next from the games you own

description.p: UpNext gathers your game libraries into one list, looks up what each game is like, and when you say what you're in the mood for, such as about an hour of something calm with a bit of story, it suggests a few games from your backlog that fit, with the reasons.

ul.li: Steam, and Epic, GOG and Amazon through the Heroic launcher, read from their own files on this computer
Details for every game: genres, tags, review scores and what players say
Picks from an AI you choose (an API key, a server of your own, or Claude Code), or from UpNext's own ranking with no AI at all
A taste profile you can read and edit, which learns from what you play
Big screen: a layout for a gamepad, a Steam Deck or a TV
Phones and other computers on your network can use it too, once you allow them on this computer

description.p: Everything is kept in a database on this computer. UpNext reads the Steam and Heroic folders and never changes them.

screenshot.caption: A request, and a lineup of three games with what players say about each
Big screen, for a gamepad, a Steam Deck or a TV

description.p: Add games from no store by hand, run the AI with a GitHub Copilot plan, and a livelier preview on picks, with many fixes.
The first release with a Flatpak, and a new icon.
